title: BigBoy - Visual Novel
description:
Welcome!If you like what you read, please make some noise about it so I can continue to deliver the rest of the story and the new ones.

Thank you!

Об игреWitness to the sections of BigBoy's life sucked into a vortex of crime. Is there divine justice?

BigBoy is a visual crime novel in a black and white style.

This is the prologue of the story.

Features
• 48 Scenes

• Languages: English & Turkish

• Black & White art style

• 1 Ending

• Auto Save

• Unique Storyline

GamePlay
Pull that trigger, be part of the story!
